name: Bacchus
text: Bacchus is the Roman name of the god of wine and growth in the old world. The dictionary turns the reader of this word to the larger entry on the same god under his Greek name. That piece tells how the god of wine was known to the Romans also as a second name. Some scholars find here a likeness to an Irish hero.

attributes.attribute: Roman name of the god of wine

okr.objective: Record Bacchus as the Roman god of wine.
